newsitem.title: USA: CNN interested in CBS's Dan Rather.
newsitem.headline: CNN interested in CBS's Dan Rather.

text.p: Cable News Network, which failed to woo NBC News anchorman Tom Brokaw last month, said Monday it has set its sights on Dan Rather, the anchorman at Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS News.
"If Dan Rather were to become available, CNN would be interested," a CNN spokesman said. Rather is in the middle of a contract with CBS that expires in 1999.
Rather, who was on vacation, was unavailable for comment. CBS declined comment, except to say, "We're very fortunate that Dan's in the middle of a multi-year contract."

CNN, a unit of Time Warner Inc, has been seeking a big-name anchor to help boost its sagging ratings. It tried to lure Brokaw with a long-term, multimillion-dollar contract, but the anchor last month chose to renew his contract with NBC, a unit of General Electric Co.
